notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Commanders![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/6b70bc8f58e3ccbd0a630fd57173f9d6c15f53bc.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that [b]Patch 3.3[/b] brings [b]new language support[/b] to [i]Three Skies Ascension[/i]. To celebrate this occasion, we are adding a [b]34% Discount for the game![/b] With this update, players around the world can experience the game in their native language and dive deeper into the world of [i]Three Skies[/i] with fully localized menus, dialogue, and gameplay elements.

Click here to get the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197690/Three_Skies_Ascension/ 

[h3]New Languages Available[/h3]

You can now play [i]Three Skies Ascension[/i] in the following languages:

[list]
[*] [b]Spanish[/b]
[*] [b]German[/b]
[*] [b]French[/b] 
[*] [b]Italian [/b]
[*] [b]Portuguese[/b]
[*] [b]Japanese[/b] 
[/list]

Whether you're a seasoned strategist or just beginning your journey, these options will help more players immerse themselves in the story, mechanics, and lore of the game.

[h3]How to Change Your Language[/h3]

Switching to your preferred language is quick and easy:

3. Select your preferred language from the list.
4. Close the Options menu and enjoy the game in your chosen language.

That’s it! Your settings will save automatically.

---

We’re always working to make [i]Three Skies Ascension[/i] more accessible to players around the world. If you have feedback on the new localizations or spot anything that could be improved, we’d love to hear from you. Thank you for your continued support, and see you in the skies!

[i][b]~Three Skies Ascension Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Devlog: Elements and Counters
notes.content:
[h2]Elements and Counters in [b]Three Skies Ascension[/b][/h2]

One of the most important layers of strategy in [b]Three Skies Ascension[/b] is the [b]element system[/b]. This system adds tactical depth to both combat and team-building by influencing a hero or creature’s strengths, weaknesses, and immunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/432be394ea98cf5a24f9be5ed91e2aa04e5762e0.png[/img]

[h3]The Element System: 14 Unique Forces[/h3]

The game features [b]14 elements[/b], each with distinct design influences and gameplay effects. Heroes and creatures may be aligned [b]with one or two elements[/b], while every skill is tied to [b]a single element[/b]. This alignment directly impacts how much damage a skill deals to an enemy.

[h3]Element Effectiveness: Multipliers that Matter[/h3]

Each element interacts differently with others. For example, Fire will deal double damage to Nature, while only dealing half damage to Water. Some elements might even be totally immune to others. These interactions result in [b]effectiveness multipliers[/b] ranging from:

[b]0x, 0.5x, 1x,[/b] and [b]2x[/b]

When an attack targets a creature or hero with [b]two elements[/b], the final damage multiplier is calculated as an [b]average[/b] of the effectiveness against both elements. This means the final multiplier will always fall into one of the following values:

[b]0x, 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x,[/b] and [b]4x[/b]

This encourages smart counter-picking and well-rounded team composition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/decb997be9c417624e67c6c31bbc9279cb6cc797.png[/img]

[h3]Artifact Modifiers: Boosting Elemental Impact[/h3]

Artifacts add another layer of complexity to combat. Some artifacts directly modify elemental effectiveness or damage output. For example:

[b]The Favored[/b] – If you deal [b]2x effectiveness or higher[/b], the skill’s damage is increased by [b]25%[/b].

These bonuses can turn a strong move into a finishing blow if paired strategically with elemental counters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/3bca2b1ac4ae9c22e08d984e8279dd068150f2a0.png[/img]

We also offer a built-in [b]element reference guide[/b]. Clicking on any element in the UI will show its strengths, weaknesses, and related abilities, helping you quickly determine which heroes to bring into battle.

[h3]Elemental Immunities: Hidden Defensive Power[/h3]

Each element also provides a [b]unique immunity[/b] to a status effect. This encourages players to consider not only offensive synergy, but also [b]defensive resilience[/b] when choosing heroes.

Here’s a quick overview of the immunities granted by each element:

| [b]Element [/b]| [b]Immunity[/b]   |
| ----------- | -------------- |
| Fire        | Frozen         |
| Water       | Burn           |
| Nature      | Ground Effects |
| Earth       | Shock          |
| Ice         | Stun           |
| Shock       | Bind           |
| Steel       | Bleed          |
| Arcane      | Taunt          |
| Shadow      | Spirit         |
| Holy        | Possession     |
| Demonic     | Poison         |
| Spirit      | Martial        |
| Martial     | Sleep          |
| Illusion    | Polymorph      |

These immunities can be the key to surviving difficult encounters, especially when enemies rely on crowd control or status-heavy tactics.

[h3]Final Thoughts[/h3]

The element system in [b]Three Skies Ascension[/b] is more than just a rock-paper-scissors mechanic. It’s a [b]core gameplay pillar[/b] that affects everything from combat flow to hero progression. Mastering this system is crucial for players aiming to tackle the hardest dungeons and build competitive teams.

Let us know your favorite elemental combos or team setups. We’d love to feature community strategies in future posts.

If you want to learn more about the Fusion System, here is a link to the full Dev Blog - 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3197690/view/814696363551885060

We're always eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions. Have a great day, and remember, your feedback is invaluable! 

[i][b]~Three Skies Ascension Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Transformation from Gacha Game to Creature Collector RPG
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, Commanders![/h1]

[h2]🔥Today, we would like to talk about the transition from Gacha Game to Creature Collector RPG  
[b]How Three Skies [/b]Became [b]Three Skies Ascension[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/f1c4a6f688a22b625610e7a86a6fc5b1a4037f31.png[/img]

We first announced *Three Skies* here in 2023 as a gacha-style game, but since then, we've taken the project in an exciting new direction. With the release of *Three Skies Ascension*, the game has fully transitioned into a [b]Creature Collector RPG[/b]. This post is for those of you who may have seen us a few years ago, and for anyone curious about how a gacha game can evolve into something hopefully deeper and more dynamic.

[h3]🚫No More Microtransactions. No More Gacha.[/h3]
Unlike traditional gacha systems that rely on "pulls" and currency grinding, *Three Skies Ascension* offers [b]capture-based recruitment[/b] similar to Pokémon and [b]negotiation-based hero recruitment[/b] for a more organic and strategic experience.

You can still earn valuable [b]Recruit Orders[/b] that give you a random hero drop, keeping a bit of that classic gacha-style excitement, but the core experience now focuses on [b]player agency and gameplay-driven progression[/b].

[h3]⚒️Rebuilding Core Systems[/h3]
We overhauled every major system that was designed to support gacha mechanics and replaced them with more meaningful, gameplay-focused alternatives. This includes rethinking how rewards, character growth, and progression work across the game.

We're still brainstorming ways to repurpose legacy systems like [b]banners, battle passes, and event menus[/b] into fun and evergreen content. More on that later.

[h2]🆕What’s New in *Three Skies Ascension*[/h2]

[h3]🗺️Campaign Expansion and Difficulty[/h3]
The original version of *Three Skies* featured just five areas. With *Ascension*, we’ve expanded the campaign to [b]twelve unique regions[/b], each with their own [b]visual novel-style dialogue[/b] and story-driven content.  

Considering that originally we were inspired by games like *Darkest Dungeon* for creating our dungeons, we also wanted to make sure that the gameplay felt challenging while also rewarding players for that challenge. 

We now tie player progression to the main story, rather than allowing open-ended grinding, which would otherwise allow the player to trivialize the content by overleveling for every boss. However, there's still a great benefit to grinding content in each zone, as it allows you to earn rewards and prepare your heroes even further.

We also amped up the enemy encounters, bringing more diversity to the style of fights you face, with the intention of keeping players on their toes.

New encounter types include:
[list]
[*] [b]Hero Encounters[/b] – Recruitable heroes through negotiation  
[*] [b]Handler Encounters[/b] – Enemy teams led by powerful AI heroes
[*] [b]Elite Encounters[/b] - Enemies with higher stats and powerful perks
[*] [b]Radiant (Shiny) Variants[/b] – Unique palette-swapped versions of heroes or creatures
[/list]

[h3]☀️The Challenge System – *Order of the Sun*[/h3]
Side dungeons are now repeatable and linked to a new [b]challenge system[/b] overseen by the *Order of the Sun*. These challenges let you customize difficulty levels and reward you with currency to spend in a special shop.

You can exchange that currency for rare gear, additional recruit orders, powerful artifacts, and more. This system is designed to give skilled players more control and a clear path to mastering the game.

[h3]⚔️Combat and Skill System Overhaul  [/h3]
We’ve made some significant improvements to combat:

[b]Swap Skills[/b]
Each hero can now assign one of their skills as a [b]Swap Skill[/b], which can be triggered from the backline to swap them into the fight. This opens up new tactical options and combo opportunities.  

Using a swap skill does come with a tradeoff - it applies a [b]4-round cooldown[/b] to the skill used.

[b]EX Skill System[/b]
The updated EX system now builds up to [b]10 charges[/b] through spending your hero's MP during a fight. These charges unlock [b]Grimoire Abilities[/b], powerful upgrades that can turn the tide of battle or save you in critical moments.

[b]Skill Customization[/b]
We also revamped the skill upgrade system. Each hero skill can be improved by four ranks, and each rank offers [b]multiple modifiers[/b] to choose from. This lets you personalize your playstyle and fine-tune your team.

[h3]🧰The Workshop[/h3]
Previously, dungeon supplies could only be purchased beforehand and would convert to gold if unused. Now, with the new [b]Workshop[/b], you can [b]craft upgraded items[/b] that stay in your inventory after each run.  

The Workshop also allows you to create [b]scrolls and fusion materials[/b] to support hero development and progression.

[h3]🎒Expeditions[/h3]
The old real-time expedition system has been replaced with something more integrated. Now, expeditions are actual [b]dungeon runs[/b] that your sideline heroes complete based on your own in-game progress.

Expedition time is reduced when your selected heroes have elemental advantages, which ties the system directly to your team-building strategy.

[h3]🛖Barracks Upgrades[/h3]
The [b]Barracks[/b] now supports [b]16 rooms by default[/b], doubling the previous capacity without requiring upgrades. We also added sorting and filtering options based on player feedback to improve quality of life.

[h3]🌟Passive System[/h3]  
As you explore dungeons, you may come across encounters that [b]grant or alter passive traits[/b] on your heroes. These passives can be [b]beneficial or harmful[/b], and vary in duration from temporary to semi-permanent, adding depth and unpredictability to dungeon crawling.

[h3]🛕Fusion Tower[/h3]
The [b]Fusion Tower[/b] replaces the old Arcane Library. Previously used for skill research, which now lives in the hero menu, the Fusion Tower now allows us to reimagine the building as a [b]hero creation and alteration system[/b].  

With [b]Fusion[/b], you can combine two heroes or creatures to create a new one, using modifier items to influence the outcome.  
With [b]Alteration[/b], you can directly change aspects of a hero, such as nature, talents, passives, and even visuals. It’s a robust system for players who enjoy refining their roster.

[h3]🐺Encounter Expansion[/h3]
Encounters have been greatly expanded. Every zone now features [b]thematic props and obstacles[/b] with different outcomes depending on your interaction choices. You can also now [b]use any item from your inventory on encounters[/b], often triggering special results.

The wildest example of this is our new Alchemy Table, which can take [b]up to 15 different items[/b] to produce varying results for your team during a dungeon run.

[h3]📓Journal Expansion[/h3]
The [b]Journal[/b] has been overhauled to include not only heroes and creatures, but also [b]celestials, artifacts, and scrolls[/b]. You can also now track your [b]collection progress[/b] in one dedicated space.

[h3]Looking Ahead  [/h3]
As mentioned, some of the old systems, like [b]event banners and battle passes[/b], are currently on hold. We’re exploring ways to reinvent them as permanent features that enhance long-term play, rather than short-term grinds.

In the meantime, our focus is on:
[list]
[*] Quality of life improvements  
[*] Endgame content
[*] Additional platform and localization support.
[*] Offline mode
[/list]

[h2]Final Thoughts  [/h2]
*Three Skies Ascension* is no longer a gacha game with RPG elements. It’s a full [b]Creature Collector RPG[/b] shaped by player choice, meaningful progression, and flexible systems.  

We appreciate anyone who has followed us on this journey and welcome both new players and returning fans. The world of *Three Skies* has grown, and there’s still more to come.

Thanks for reading!  
[i][b]~Chris, Shiny Box Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Dev Blog: Inside the Fusion System
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey adventurers![/b][/h2]

Today we’re pulling back the curtain on one of the most exciting mechanics in our game—[b]The Fusion System[/b]! Found within the [b]Fusion Tower[/b], this feature is a cornerstone of deep hero customization and team-building strategy. Whether you're looking to create a brand new hero or fine-tune your favorite warrior, the Fusion System gives you the tools to shape your barracks like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/c5abe3f6a219a5f736bf54afe8ffbf418b76e199.png[/img]

[h3]🧬 What is Fusion?[/h3]

The Fusion Tower has [b]two major functions[/b]:

1. [b]Fusion[/b] – Create an entirely [b]new hero or creature[/b] based on two selected "parents."  
2. [b]Alteration[/b] – Modify certain [b]aspects of an existing hero[/b] instantly with special items.

Let’s break them down!

[h3]🧪 Fusion: Forge a New Hero[/h3]

Fusion allows you to combine [b]any two heroes or creatures[/b]—your chosen "parents"—to create a brand new being. The outcome depends heavily on the [b]power level and attributes of the parents[/b], so mix wisely!

But there's more to it than just throwing two characters together. You can also use **modifying items** to influence the result. These items give you control over what traits might be passed on, such as:

🔹 Preserving a parent’s [b]Nature[/b]  
🔹 Preserving a parent’s [b]Talent [/b]
🔹 Inheriting [b]two additional attributes[/b] from the parents  
🔹 Passing down a [b]specific attribute[/b]

Once your selections are made and modifiers are applied, your new fusion hero begins to take form—but you’ll need to [b]progress through dungeon exploration[/b] to complete the process. This makes the fusion not only strategic, but something that evolves with your gameplay.

[h3]✨ Alteration: Redefine Your Heroes[/h3]

Sometimes you don’t want to start from scratch—you just want to [b]tweak [/b]a hero you already love. That’s where [b]Alteration[/b] comes in.

Using special [b]alteration items[/b], you can instantly change parts of a hero, such as:

- 🔁 Swapping their [b]Nature[/b]
- 🎯 Changing their [b]Talent[/b]  
- ❌ Removing unwanted [b]passives[/b]  
- 🔧 Boosting [b]specific attributes[/b]  
- 🎨 Applying [b]special palettes[/b] for a visual refresh

Unlike Fusion, Alteration happens [b]immediately[/b], allowing for quick experimentation and fine-tuning of your roster.

[h3]🔮 Why This Matters[/h3]

The Fusion System is more than just a mechanic—it’s about [b]player expression[/b] and [b]strategic depth[/b]. Whether you’re crafting a hero that fits your playstyle or customizing your squad to overcome tough challenges, this system gives you the flexibility to build your dream team.

So dive in, experiment, and discover the endless possibilities hiding inside the Fusion Tower. And don’t forget—sometimes the strongest heroes are the ones you create yourself.

Until next time,  
[i][b]~ The Dev Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Devlog: Our Inspirations for the Game
notes.content:
[h1]Inspirations for the Game[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210445/3f7a192eb44d107651f1875d9ed26ad19211cdfe.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hey Commanders![/b][/h3]
In today’s devlog, we want to share the heart of our project—our inspirations. Everything has a story behind it, from the mechanics to the story to the characters, and we hope this gives you insight into our creative process. Let’s jump right in!

[h3][b]The Big Idea: A Grown-Up Pokémon in a Fantasy World[/b][/h3]
I have always dreamed of making something like Pokémon, but it was a bit more challenging and set in a classic fantasy world. Think of it as Pokémon for grown-ups, with a deeper strategy and a story-driven edge.

Another inspiration came from Pokémon Showdown. I’ve always admired its competitive system and how you can build multiple teams. It got me thinking—how cool would it be to create a game where collecting heroes/creatures has more strategic depth? That’s why team-building and diverse strategies are at the core of this game.

Finally, watching my wife obsess over Darkest Dungeon was a game-changer (literally). I loved its risk-vs.-reward mechanics and the tension of dungeon diving—but let’s be real, it’s a bit grueling. I wanted to recreate that nail-biting survival feeling with a less punishing twist.

[h3][b]Gameplay: Fast-paced and Full of Strategy[/b][/h3]
Combat is inspired by Pokémon, but we’ve made it faster and more fitting for a fantasy setting. Here’s how we spiced things up:
[list]
[*] [b]Combat Text and Logs:[/b] We replaced lengthy callouts with combat text and added a log so you can keep track of the action.
[*] [b]Swap Skills:[/b] This new feature lets you call in backline heroes to act immediately, saving time and adding strategy. Each swap skill has a unique cooldown, so choose wisely!
[*] [b]Mana and Blood Magic:[/b] Instead of PP, we use mana and blood magic. Mana replenishes when heroes are on the backline, encouraging swaps for more action. Out of mana? Use blood magic—at the cost of your health—for a risk-vs-reward twist.
[*] [b]Grimoires:[/b] As the battle progresses, you earn EX, which can be spent on powerful modifiers granted from your Commander’s Grimoires. Mix and match grimoires to find the best strategy for your team!
[/list]

[h3][b]Visuals: A Blend of East and West[/b][/h3]
Our art style takes cues from some of our favorite Western games like Warcraft and League of Legends, infused with some inspiration from our favorite anime games like Epic Seven. We ended up with more anime/cartoon vibes against more detailed backgrounds for our characters. We aimed to have our characters set up to quickly swap to different palettes to allow various "shiny" versions per hero and creature.

[h3][b]Story: Mythology Meets Serious Tone[/b][/h3]
The story is a collaboration between me and my good friend Tom Keaten (Three Skies). We wanted a world rich in mythology. Inspirations like Lord of the Rings and Brandon Sanderson’s world-building influenced us heavily. Writing for a game—especially one as dialogue-heavy as this—was challenging for Tom, but what was the result? A story we’re proud of, clocking in at 100,000 words (that’s a 300+ page book!).

[h3][b]Character Spotlight: A Few Favorites[/b][/h3]
Designing characters was a team effort. Everyone, even contractors, had a chance to contribute. Here are a few highlights:

[list]
[*] Evelyn: Inspired by Eevee (Pokémon), with many “evolutions” (which we call promotions).
[*] Pokey: A humanoid opossum inspired by my wife, who calls every opossum she sees “Pokey.”
[*] Luxfur: A coyote-like creature inspired by a funny moment where an Italian character exclaimed, “Itsa coyoteee!” His name also means “light thief” in Latin.
[*] Havel: A tribute to the heavy armor character from Dark Souls. Our heaviest tank character carries his name.
[*] Jeanne: A nod to Joan of Arc, a staple archetype in many gacha games, now reimagined for our lore.
[/list]

We’ll share more characters in future devlogs—stay tuned!

[h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3]
In the next devlog, we’ll discuss the dungeon-diving mechanics and how we make every encounter feel unique and rewarding.

Do you have questions or feedback? Drop them in the comments—we’d love to hear from you!

Thanks for reading, and see you next time! 🙌

notes.title: Three Skies Ascension - Announcement + Demo Available
notes.content:
[h2]Announcing Three Skies Ascension – A New Chapter Begins![/h2]

We’re excited to officially announce Three Skies Ascension, the reimagined version of Three Skies. In this all-new update, we’ve made some major changes that we believe will offer an even more immersive and engaging experience for both longtime fans and new players alike.

[h3]What's Different?[/h3]

The biggest change is that Three Skies Ascension is no longer a gacha game. Instead, we’ve put a stronger focus on collecting and bonding with new heroes and creatures. Every hero and creature is now available for you to collect in-game without any luck-based currency systems. This shift means that Three Skies Ascension will be a fully paid, single-player experience. No gacha mechanics, no currency needed to save for draws—just a world filled with heroes and creatures waiting for you to bond with. 

[h3]A Full-Fledged Single-Player Adventure[/h3]

Three Skies Ascension offers a deep, story-driven RPG adventure spread across 12 unique areas. Each area is packed with content, dialogue, and story that could fill an entire book. 

[h3]New Progression, New Systems, Same World[/h3]

Every single system from the original game has been carefully reworked for a more streamlined and enjoyable single-player RPG experience. Our progression system is now focused on player enjoyment, not longevity or grind. Progress at your own pace, uncover secrets, and build the perfect team of heroes and creatures as you experience this epic journey.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Expanded Dungeons[/b] – All dungeon layouts have been reimagined and expanded to offer a deeper, more thrilling experience.
[*][b]Dynamic Encounters[/b] – Interact with items during encounters for diverse, unpredictable outcomes.
[*][b]Swap Skills[/b] – Unleash powerful swap skills when bringing heroes from the backline into the fray.
[*][b]Grimoires[/b] – Equip your commander with customizable grimoire abilities that enhance and modify your heroes' combat skills.
[*][b]Ascension[/b] – Take any hero or creature to the ultimate rarity level—UR, unlocking their true potential.
[*][b]Gear Sets[/b] – Effortlessly manage your team’s equipment with shareable gear loadouts between heroes.
[*][b]Fusion[/b] – Combine two heroes to create a unique fusion hero, blending their abilities into something entirely new.
[*][b]Alteration[/b] – Modify nearly any aspect of your heroes, giving you full control over their evolution.
[*][b]Shop[/b] – Visit the revamped vendor for an array of valuable items to aid you on your journey.
[*][b]Passive Abilities[/b] – Unlock a variety of passive skills as you adventure, shaping your heroes’ roles in creative ways.
[*][b]Bonding System[/b] – Deepen relationships with heroes by choosing the right responses to persuade them to join your cause.
[*][b]Expeditions[/b] – Send surplus heroes on full dungeon runs while you continue your main adventure.
[*][b]Workshop[/b] – Craft essential items to teach skills, capture creatures, or alter your heroes.
[*][b]Expanded Barracks[/b] – Collect even more heroes and creatures with the barracks now doubled in capacity.
[*][b]Advanced Promotions[/b] – Promote any hero or creature without altering their elements or visuals.
[*][b]Task System[/b] – Complete new tasks after every dungeon run for lucrative rewards.
[*][b]Updated Combat UI[/b] – Enjoy a more streamlined and intuitive interface, making battle options easier to access and navigate.
[*][b]Updated Town UI[/b] - Every town building's UI has been given the full-screen treatment.
[*][b]Expanded Journal[/b] – Track your collection of Heroes, Creatures, Celestials, Artifacts, and Scrolls with ease.
[*][b]And More to Come![/b] – Stay tuned for even more exciting updates in future releases!
[/list]
[h3]What Comes Next?[/h3]

Though Three Skies Ascension will launch as a complete experience, this is only the beginning! We’re committed to bringing larger updates post-launch, with new content, new challenges, and more opportunities to explore the world of Three Skies. Stay tuned for more details as we get closer to release!

We can’t wait to share Three Skies Ascension with you. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to embarking on this exciting new journey together.

[b]Try the demo: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197690/Three_Skies_Ascension/]Three Skies Ascension Demo[/url][/b]
